description: Package versions that entered the tree inside the 7-day maturity buffer, reviewed 7 and 14 days after publication (advisories, upstream issues, release notes), and dated milestones that ride the same list. Milestones are UTC dates derived from `published`. A review is recorded under `reviews.<milestone>` as { date, outcome: clean | flagged, note }, dated the day it is written and never later; one written up to 2 days before its milestone also carries early: { reason }, and the entry's later milestone stays due. A package entry leaves the list in the change that records its clean 14-day review; a date entry stays, with its `due` review recorded as the evidence that the day was reviewed; a package entry whose version leaves the tree before that review leaves the list too, because nothing is left to review. Read by scripts/testing/maturity-watchlist.mjs (--check in CI, --remind in the maturity-reminder workflow).

maturity.note: Reviewed 2026-10-05, six days late: the reminder workflow started on 2026-10-03 and carried no day over. OSV: nothing for 12.6.0. Upstream: pnpm 12.7.0 (2026-09-25) ships three security fixes that apply to 12.6.0 — a userAgent env placeholder in pnpm-workspace.yaml was expanded and sent to the registry; on Nix a dependency bin named like a system utility could redirect the shims and launchers; manifests inside the store, cache, state or modules directories counted as workspace projects, letting lifecycle scripts run without allowBuilds approval. 12.8.2 fixes a regression introduced in 12.6.0: pnpm run kept waiting after SIGTERM when pnpm is PID 1 in a container. 12.9.0 stops pnpm login forwarding credentials to another origin on redirect. None is reachable here today (no userAgent or storeDir configured, no Nix, the four Dockerfiles run node directly, pnpm login unused), but a package manager three security fixes behind is not kept: bump packageManager to the latest mature release in its own PR (12.8.1 from 2026-10-05T17:38Z, 12.8.2 from 2026-10-07T01:15Z, 12.9.1 from 2026-10-10T20:48Z).

final.note: Researched 2026-10-05, a day before the milestone, and recorded the same day as an early review. Registry after 12.6.0: 12.7.0 (2026-09-25T10:38Z), 12.8.0 (09-28T07:34Z), 12.8.1 (09-28T17:38Z), 12.8.2 (09-30T01:15Z), 12.9.0 (10-02T22:27Z), 12.9.1 (10-03T20:48Z, latest). OSV: nothing for 12.6.0 or 12.9.1; the newest GitHub pnpm advisories (2026-09-02) cover 10.x, 11.x and 12.0.0 alphas only. Release notes: 12.7.0 carries four security fixes for 12.6.0, not three; the fourth stops hard-linking packages that run a build script into the virtual store, where the script could rewrite an injected package's source or its store copy (#15483). 12.9.0 stops pnpm login forwarding credentials on redirect; 12.8.2 fixes 12.6.0's PID-1 SIGTERM regression. None is reachable beyond the store copies of the three packages allowed to build (prisma, @prisma/engines, esbuild): no userAgent or storeDir set, no Nix, no injected workspace package, the four images run node directly, pnpm login unused. A regression in the newer releases is reachable: 12.7.0 to 12.8.2 fail pnpm install --frozen-lockfile when a workspace project the lockfile records has no directory (pnpm/pnpm#16453, fixed in 12.9.0 by #16462), and each Dockerfile runs that install with three of the four apps absent (main's admin image build at 8400ba05, run 37265374768: 96 of the lockfile's 99 importers in scope, pnpm v12.6.0). Reproduced 2026-10-05 with one of two workspace projects removed: exit 1 ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE on 12.7.0, 12.8.0, 12.8.1 and 12.8.2; exit 0 on 12.6.0, 12.9.0 and 12.9.1. 12.9.0's package also unpacks to 55 MB (12.9.1: 4.1 MB). Flagged: the packageManager bump is still owed and its target moves to 12.9.1, mature from 2026-10-10T20:48Z, not the 12.8.1 or 12.8.2 the maturity review named; its PR reads the four 'Build container image' steps, green on main while their Container Security jobs fail at Trivy. The entry stays until that bump takes 12.6.0 out of the tree.

maturity.note: Reviewed 2026-10-05, the milestone day, researched from 17:56Z, after the 7-day buffer had closed for all ten packages (8.71.0 published 2026-09-28 between 17:09Z and 17:13Z). Registry: 8.71.0 is no longer latest: 8.71.1, after fifteen alphas, is latest for all ten since 2026-10-05T17:08Z to 17:09Z; it keeps the typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 and eslint peers, its plugin peers @typescript-eslint/parser ^8.71.1, and it matures 2026-10-12T17:08Z to 17:09Z, the final milestone's day. OSV, which carries the GitHub database: nothing for any of the ten at 8.71.0, at 8.71.1 or at any version; GitHub's global advisories and the repository's security advisories list none. Release notes: 8.71.0 adds no-unsafe-enum-assignment (#12732) and fixes switch-exhaustiveness-check, unbound-method, no-unnecessary-type-assertion and no-misused-promises; nothing on security, and none of the five is enabled here: eslint.config.ts configures no-unused-vars, no-explicit-any and no-floating-promises and spreads no typescript-eslint preset. 8.71.1's nine fixes carry nothing on security; two reach this configuration: no-unused-vars now reports a value used only as a type when a same-named type is exported (#12892, closing #10658 of 2025-01-15: a false negative, not a regression of 8.71.0), and the project service throttles its cleanup when opening files (#12934). Upstream issues: five opened since 2026-09-28, the search and the issues API agreeing; three name no-unsafe-enum-assignment (#12951 and #12956 closed, #12966 open), #12947 asks for a no-shadow option, and #12940 (no-unnecessary-type-parameters, fixed in 8.71.1 by #12941) was opened hours before 8.71.0; none names the parser, the project service or a rule enabled here. Reachability, the lockfile parsed with yaml.safe_load_all and walked uncut: no production dependency of the 99 importers reaches any of the ten; they come only through the devDependencies of the root and of packages/eslint-plugin-testing. Works here: PR #421 recorded pnpm lint --max-warnings 0 (no cache) and pnpm exec tsc -b --force exit 0 on 8.71.0, @packages/eslint-plugin-testing, whose RuleTester parses TypeScript, 67/67, and the battery on its tip dbbfeeb6 green (15:06Z to 15:27Z, 21 steps exit 0). The holds gate, re-run at 17:59Z, exits 0 with both packages at or above latest mature (target 8.71.0, 8.71.1 being inside the buffer); evaluated at --instant 2026-10-12T17:11Z it names both as an undocumented lag against 8.71.1, so the move to 8.71.1, or a pre-registered hold row, is owed by 2026-10-12T17:08Z. Clean; the 14-day review is due 2026-10-12.
